definitions: To talk about something that has been worrying you for a long time so that you feel relieved.
To confess something that has been bothering you.
examples: I need to get something off my chest about what happened yesterday.
He finally got it off his chest and told her how he felt.
It's good to get things off your chest sometimes.
lemma: to get something off your chest
synonyms: to make a clean breast of it
source: to get something off your chest
